The vendor directly providing **Jetpack** at **jetpack.com** is **Automattic Inc.** (Automattic).

### Evidence & Provider Statements
* **Jetpack Privacy Center (`jetpack.com`):** *"Automattic owns and operates the Jetpack plugin"* and references the *Automattic Privacy Notice* and *Automattic Terms of Service*.
* **Jetpack Agreements & Legal Pages (`jetpack.com`):** The *Jetpack Agency Platform Agreement* defines the provider as *"Automattic, Inc. ('Automattic')"*, and the site copyright states: *"© Automattic Inc. All rights reserved. Made with care by Automattic."*
